text:
mira: Heads up — found a plaintext partner webhook secret in telemetry logs during a routine scan. I redacted the actual value but we need an immediate containment + rotation plan. Looks scoped to partners/acme webhook path.
ops-bot: alert: secret-detection v0.9 — 1 match in prod-telemetry stream. report: https://internal/reports/9201234567 (auto) :warning:

sara: can you paste the redacted log line and last-seen timestamp?
mira: log snippet (redacted): `2026-03-23T14:02:15Z INFO webhook delivered payload partner_id=acme tenant=acme env=prod webhook_key=**REDACTED**` — last seen ~2026-03-23T14:02:15Z UTC.

security_oncall: assume compromise. Immediate steps I propose: 1) contain — stop any automated jobs that read the partner key; 2) rotate the key on our side and request partner rotate if they accept; 3) change Vault/KMS wrapping to a new key; 4) restrict RBAC to reduce blast radius; 5) capture audit records and open incident ticket. I'll open SEC-2026-17.

leo: current infra notes: we store the value at `secret/data/partners/acme/webhook` (KV v2). Vault record shows version 3. I recommend creating a new secret path `secret/data/partners/acme/webhook-v4` and write the new key wrapped with KMS key `projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/rw/cryptoKeys/partner-rotate`. Then update service consumers to read fallback-first from v4 then delete v3. Also ephemeral tokens for rollout.

sara: quick q — do we want to rewrap the existing ciphertext or generate a brand new secret? rewrap only changes envelope but if plaintext leaked elsewhere we still have to rotate at partner.
mira: partner says they can't rotate on their side immediately (24h delay) and asked for IOCs. We can revoke our outgoing token and create a short-lived proxy token in front of them.

security_oncall: rewrap is not sufficient here. We need rotation: generate new secret and push to partner or ask partner to rotate. Containment actions: A) disable CI/service account `ingest-runner` read capability for the partner path; B) create a maintainer ephemeral token (ttl=1h) for debugging; C) start rotation job; D) redact logs retention for the affected window. I'll run the RBAC change if owners ack.

leo: draft RBAC change (vault CLI):
```
vault policy write deny-partner-ingest - <<'EOF'
path "secret/data/partners/acme/webhook" {
  capabilities = ["deny"]
}
EOF
```
Then patch k8s secret-agent roleBinding to point to new path and restart agent. We'll do a staged rollout to staging first.

sara: ack to the plan. I'll coordinate the k8s secret sync and the CI rotation job. Proposed rotation script snippet for ops:
```
#!/bin/bash
set -e
# rotate_partner_key.sh
OLD_PATH="secret/data/partners/acme/webhook"
NEW_PATH="secret/data/partners/acme/webhook-v4"
# generate new key locally (or via partner API)
NEW_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
vault kv put ${NEW_PATH} key=${NEW_KEY} metadata=rotated_by=automation
# wrap with KMS
gcloud kms encrypt --location global --keyring rw --key partner-rotate --plaintext-file <(printf "%s" "$NEW_KEY") --ciphertext-file /tmp/new_key.ct
# update deployments to read NEW_PATH (canary rollout)
```

ops-bot: CI trigger: `rotations/partner-acme/9201234567` queued by sara.

mira: Also: enable Vault audit device and ensure KMS audit logs are exported to our security project for the window. We need to capture token reads and replays.

security_oncall: commands to run: `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_audit.log` and confirm GCP audit log sink for `partner-rotate` key is active for 90d. I'll add explicit log retention + alert for any reads from old path.

leo: will prepare terraform change for policy + secret-agent roleBinding: small diff so it can be fast-tracked.

sara: assigning tasks: sara -> run rotation CI + sync k8s secret-agent, leo -> RBAC policy + tf change, mira -> partner comms and log redaction timeline, security_oncall -> incident tracking + audit hooks. I'll update SEC-2026-17 with check-ins. :thumbsup:

mira: thanks. One request — after rotation confirm we run an automated scan over log retention window to ensure no other occurrences.

security_oncall: noted. Post-rotation: 1) delete old secret version from KV v2, 2) revoke any stored tokens that had access, 3) run detection across logging buckets, 4) follow up with partner.

sara: will update ticket and ping eng-sre for log scrub timeline.

ops-bot: note: automated reminder scheduled in 30m to check on progress for SEC-2026-17.

mira: I'll post final proof-of-action to ticket once rotation completes. Thanks all.
